name: packages.remove_obsolete
description: Purge packages an in-place release upgrade left behind: installed, offered by no configured source, and built for an older release. When it runs it skips any listed package that isn't such a leftover, and refuses before changing anything while a running process loads one of their libraries or if the purge simulation would remove or install any other package. It can't be undone: no configured source offers these versions any more.
health_check: The helper confirms with dpkg that the packages are gone.
